headings.usage: Use Outfit for all Headings, Display text, and Numbers. Always use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Use Inter for body text, form inputs, and small labels. Use tracking-normal.

typography.install_command: Ensure Google Fonts for Outfit and Inter are included in index.html.

colors.mesh_gradient: Apple-style mesh gradient background using pure CSS. A pure #060311 base with massive, slow-moving radial blobs of Purple, Deep Blue, and Orange at 15-20% opacity. This creates a luxurious, breathing dark mode without overwhelming text.

glassmorphism.usage: Use for Navbar, Dashboard Cards, Competition Cards, and Modals.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Gap-8 to gap-12 for grids.
grids_and_layouts.page_structure: Every page with a floating navbar needs an appropriate pt-32 top padding to prevent content from hiding under it.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For the Hero, Wallet, and Dashboard sections, use asymmetric bento grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, varying spans like col-span-8 and col-span-4) instead of standard even columns.

components.navbar: Floating Glass Nav: fixed top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[95%] max-w-7xl rounded-full bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 z-50 px-6 py-4. Mobile menu must use a solid dark background or very heavy blur.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF5E00] to-[#FF3300], text-white, font-bold, hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300, shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,94,0,0.4)]
buttons.secondary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), bg-white/5 text-white border border-white/20 hover:bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm transition-all duration-300

components.competition_card: Crystal Glass card. Image container at the top (h-64, overflow-hidden, rounded-t-2xl), followed by p-6 content. Include a vibrant, glowing progress bar for 'Tickets Sold'. Image must zoom slightly on hover.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs heavily customized: bg-white/5 border-white/10 text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#8B3DFF] focus:border-transparent rounded-xl transition-all duration-300.

motion.hover: All cards lift slightly (-translate-y-2) and increase border opacity (border-white/20) with transition-transform duration-300.
motion.page_transitions: Framer motion fade and slight slide-up (initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}) for major sections.
motion.mesh_animation: Slow pulsing CSS keyframes on the background.

pages.HomePage: Hero: Massive Outfit text 'Câștigă Imposibilul' (Win the Impossible), 3D-like floating sports car image. Bento grid of 'Featured Competitions' below.
pages.CompetitionsPage: Filter chips at the top (Cars, Tech, Cash). Grid of Competition Cards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3).
pages.CompetitionDetailPage: Split layout: Sticky image gallery on left, ticket purchasing console (glassmorphism) on right. Floating 'Adaugă în coș' (Add to Cart) bar on mobile.
pages.SubscriptionsPage: 3 massive glass cards. Middle card scaled up slightly with an Orange glow ring (Tracing Beam effect) to highlight the best tier.
pages.WalletPage: High-density grid. Top card: Big balance. Bottom: Transaction list. Neo-brutalist tech feel for data.
pages.DashboardPage: User stats bento grid. 'Active Tickets' horizontal scroller.
pages.AdminPage: Sidebar layout. Dense data. Use strict grids. Keep the mesh background extremely subtle or use pure #060311 to maintain focus on data.
pages.CartPage: Minimalist glass checkout flow. High trust signals (lock icons, secure payment badges).
pages.WinnersPage: Masonry grid of winner photos with celebratory orange/purple glow effects behind each photo card.
pages.FAQPage: Shadcn Accordion customized with border-b-white/10, text-white.
pages.AuthPages: Centered glassmorphism form card over the most intense part of the mesh gradient background.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text over the glass backgrounds passes WCAG AA. If the mesh gradient gets too bright, increase the backdrop blur or add a bg-black/40 overlay to the card.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='buy-ticket-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building Zektrix UK, a premium lottery/competition platform. Install framer-motion if not present.
Add 'Outfit' and 'Inter' fonts via Google Fonts in your index.html or layout file.

Implement the background using pure CSS in index.css: A fixed full-screen body background. Set background-color: #060311, and use radial-gradient and CSS @keyframes to create a slow-moving, breathing Apple-style mesh gradient using the colors hsla(263,100%,60%,0.15) (Purple), hsla(22,100%,50%,0.1) (Orange), and hsla(240,100%,50%,0.15) (Blue).
All cards must follow the 'Crystal Glass' variant: bg-white/5, backdrop-blur-2xl, border-white/10. Do not use pure gray solid backgrounds.
Use Outfit for Headings (tracking-tight) and Inter for Body text. DO NOT center-align main text; use optical alignment (left-aligned mostly).
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, modals, or mobile menus where content overlaps. Give them a solid #060311 background or heavily blurred opaque background.
Implement image lazy loading (loading='lazy') to maintain performance.
Maintain the user's requirement: All existing functionality must keep working. Do not drop existing logic, just reskin and modernize the UI. Do not delete or break the wallet/ticket flows.
Language is primarily Romanian. Use Romanian for placeholders if writing new text, but keep variable names English.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth with layered design elements and z-index.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
DO NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped, glowing hover states).
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., p-8, p-12).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, scaling).
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
Components MUST use named exports, Pages MUST use default exports.
Use sonner for toasts. Do not use default alert().
